neighbours.label: two unrelated things: places in Virginia's Tidewater and Northern Virginia (the Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton Roads, Tangier Island, McLean) and the world of the Elder Scrolls games (Skyrim, Morrowind, Cyrodiil, Tamriel); other bays, shipyards, suburbs and fantasy games stay low
fire: The ferry crosses the Chesapeake from Cape Charles to Norfolk.
Her father welded hulls at the Newport News yard for thirty years.
The senator's house in McLean backs onto the Potomac.
Oyster boats work the shallows off Tangier Island.
Hampton Roads traffic backs up at the tunnel every evening.
The Dragonborn shouts at the dragon in Skyrim.
Morrowind is the third Elder Scrolls game.
quiet: The ferry crosses Delaware Bay from Lewes to Cape May.
Her father welded hulls at the Bath Iron Works for thirty years.
The senator's house in Bethesda backs onto the Potomac.
Oyster boats work the shallows off Wellfleet.
Boston traffic backs up at the tunnel every evening.
Link swings his sword at the dragon in Hyrule.
Majora's Mask is the sixth Zelda game.
Players explore Azeroth in World of Warcraft.
